data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase).

**Target:** A **SKORPIUS DUNERIDER** model of yours that has not yet been **selected to move** in the phase.

**Effect:** An **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit that [disembarks](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from that model once that model has finished a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) can still declare a charge, for the rest of the turn.

effect.trigger: disembark from target after its Normal Move
